svg.title: server
svg.text: The server's data flow: handlers wait, one loop steps, tokens stream back
submit → _pending (future + queue) → EngineLoop.run: step() → _drain_streams → set_result; C joins after a sleep(0)

g.text: A finished: queue gets the end marker, future.set_result
C submits during the sleep(0) gap…
…and is in the very next step

svg.text: Each step produces ONE new token per running request; _drain_streams pushes output_token_ids[num_streamed:] to its queue.
Only the loop calls step(), and add_request runs only while the loop is paused at an await, so no locks are needed.
animated: five steps; tokens fly from the batch into each queue, then to the client; C joins mid-way, A finishes
